name: spn-os-mobile
description: SPN OS - Savannah Propagation Nursery operations app. Capacitor shell that ships the SPN ERP web app inside the APK (offline-first) and talks to the Cloudflare Worker API.

scripts.assets: node scripts/make-assets.mjs && capacitor-assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor "#F5F2E8" --iconBackgroundColorDark "#1E2B22" --splashBackgroundColor "#1E2B22" --splashBackgroundColorDark "#1E2B22" && node scripts/make-notif-assets.mjs
scripts.android:add: cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs && npm run assets
scripts.sync: npm run build:www && cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs && npm run assets
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew assembleRelease
